instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor martial arts studio with a grey floor and white walls. On the left foreground, the girl in the white uniform with a red belt (R4) performs a high block with her right arm raised and left fist at her hip. In the center background, the boy in the white uniform with a striped white belt (R2) stands with his left arm raised high and right hand on his hip. On the right foreground, the girl in the orange uniform with a blue belt (R3) raises her right arm in a high block. On the far left edge, a cropped bystander in a black uniform is partially visible. The scene is lit by soft, diffused side lighting.
